interface.alias_and_mutation_notes: Returns the same (out, initial_state) buffers. Both mutate in place; initial_state updates only ssm_state_indices. Other inputs are immutable.

contracts.value: One packed decode gated-delta step writes out in place and updates initial_state at ssm_state_indices in place, returning the same two buffers as (out, initial_state).

Live eager capture from the production callable is authoritative for values, routing, layout, output, and recurrent-state transition; deployment CUDA-graph behavior is checked separately by capture-once/replay-many in unittest.py.

The first graph-construction capture was rejected as vacuous. This promoted oracle was recaptured from the same workload with CUDA graph disabled solely so the Python seam observed real request buffers: B=64 carries 64 distinct state slots and B=1 carries slot 2. The UT restores each pre-call state/output buffer and separately reenables fixed-buffer CUDA-graph replay across B=64 and B=1.
